pr_title: planner: generate the additional filter in table filter when enable plan cache
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/28696

Problem Summary:
In previous [PR](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/28457), we generate the additional filter. But we forget the prefix index, it will cause the wrong result.

### What is changed and how it works?
If the table filter has the conditions, we should generate the additional filter above table filter.
